notes: Comprehensive collection of 100 California animal welfare organizations including municipal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, breed-specific rescues, wildlife rehabilitation centers, farm sanctuaries, horse rescues, TNR programs, spay/neuter clinics, and small animal rescues. California has the largest animal shelter system in the US. Coverage spans all major regions including Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Sacramento, Central Valley, Central Coast, and rural Northern California. SF SPCA (founded 1868) is the fourth oldest humane society in the US and founders of the No-Kill movement.
